promptPrefix: Flat 2D vector illustration in a silhouette style, simple geometric shapes, clean edges, minimal detail, soft gradient lighting, limited palette (deep purple #3a2350, warm orange #f08a4b, dark silhouette #120a18, night blue #1c2c4c, soft cream #f3e6c8, gold accent #ffcf5a), calm and reverent mood, vertical 9:16 composition.
negative: No faces of prophets or companions, no depiction of God or angels in figurative form, no text or letters, no watermark, no realistic photo style, no 3D render, no anime style.

roleHints.sky: Full-frame sky background only, no objects, no ground, at least 1080x1920.
roleHints.atmo: Only clouds or mist, isolated on a transparent background.
roleHints.far: Only distant landscape silhouettes in the lower half, transparent background above.
roleHints.mid: Only the mid-ground element, isolated on a transparent background.
roleHints.water: Only stylized wave bands in the lower half, transparent background.
roleHints.prop: Only this single object, side view, isolated on a transparent background.
roleHints.figure: Silhouette figure(s) seen from behind or far away, faceless, isolated on a transparent background.
roleHints.fg: Only foreground elements along the bottom edge, transparent background.
